_comment: Future-industries door. Each industry is listed only where an official government source names it, quoted verbatim. The quotes were string-matched (code, not a reader) against the live page or PDF text on each source's checkedOn; the Japan PDF was matched ignoring spaces, because its text layer splits words. Which degrees lead into each industry is computed from ui/topics.js and labelled as our judgement on the page.
